Dear sir/madam,
as we are updating our project (MASVS) https://github.com/OWASP/owasp-masvs/issues/189, given existing documentation in OWASP that is no longer maintained, we stumbled upon the requirements regarding responsible disclosure. Now as I am sure that we should not focus on RD in the MASVS, we were wondering: is the ASVS the place to have requirements about it? 
With kind regards,
your mobile friends ^^.
